title: Selection of Heart Sound Segments for Synchronous Classification of Multi-channel Heart Sounds
abstract: arXiv:2608.21499v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cardiac auscultation remains the most cost-effective screening procedure for cardiovascular diseases, and requires listening at the four main auscultation spots. Despite this, automatic heart sound analysis algorithms mostly classify patients using a single heart sound (single-channel), or, when using more than one (multi-channel), analyze each channel individually. To our knowledge, no prior work classifies patients through the synchronous analysis of multi-channel heart sounds, following the procedure used by physicians. This motivates us to study whether synchronous multi-channel analysis outperforms single-channel approaches, and whether it holds an advantage over asynchronous multi-channel methods that analyze channels one by one, potentially by capturing inter-channel interference phenomena. translated_title: 多通道心音同步分类的心音段选择方法
translated_abstract: 心脏听诊仍是心血管疾病最具成本效益的筛查手段，需要在四个主要听诊区进行听诊。尽管如此，自动心音分析算法大多使用单一心音（单通道）对患者进行分类，或者当使用多个心音（多通道）时，会逐个通道进行分析。据我们所知，目前没有先前工作通过同步分析多通道心音来对患者进行分类，这与医生遵循的流程不同。这促使我们研究同步多通道分析是否优于单通道方法，以及它是否比逐个分析通道的异步多通道方法更具优势，可能通过捕捉通道间干扰现象。为回答这些问题，我们引入了一种选择算法，从四个听诊区中的每个区域识别出最优心音段。
tldr: 本文提出一种心音段选择算法，首次实现多通道心音的同步分类，并验证其优于单通道和异步多通道方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a segment selection algorithm for synchronous multi-channel heart sound classification, demonstrating its superiority over single-channel and asynchronous approaches.
